visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Exterior shot of a large concrete building with a red tiled roof labeled "Visitor Center" in both Chinese and English. A young boy wearing a bright green puffer vest and gray pants walks up the gray stone stairs towards the main glass entrance. The environment is overcast with bare deciduous trees visible in the background against a pale sky. (2) Inside the visitor center, the camera follows the boy past a textured rock-wall exhibit. A large digital screen displays a vivid animation of a volcano erupting, with molten orange lava flowing down slopes under a dramatic purple and orange sunset sky. The lighting in the room is warm and focused on the displays. (3) The scene shifts to an ecological exhibit area featuring stylized model tree trunks reaching the ceiling. The walls are covered in colorful murals of birds, butterflies, and forest landscapes. Information placards with text and photographs are mounted throughout the space, and the floor is a bright, solid green color. (4) Transition to the exterior of "ushi cafe," a modern stone building. The boy stands near a glass door while a man inside is seen sitting in a leather chair. Menus with various food items and beverage photos are posted on the textured gray stone wall. The outdoor walkway is paved with large stones. (5) Interior of the cafe where the family is seated at a wooden table. A close-up shows a child using a silver fork to eat a slice of pink strawberry mille crepe cake served on a white plate. Two adults, a male in glasses and a female, sit nearby holding mugs. A yellow menu and a white vase with dried flowers are on the table.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @momanddad_band. [Subtitle]: 某個假日午後. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們來到陽明山竹子湖的遊客中心. (3) [Subtitle]: 原本只是去借個廁所. (4) [Subtitle]: 沒想到遊客中心裡這麼精彩. (5) [Subtitle]: 可以體驗大屯火山噴發的震撼. [Variety]: 砰. (6) [Subtitle]: 哇好多岩漿很燙很燙. (7) [Subtitle]: 都冒煙了~. (8) [Subtitle]: 裡面還有陽明山的生態解說. (9) [Subtitle]: 關於陽明山的季節變化與動植物的關係. (10) [Subtitle]: 還會介紹特殊物種與生物多樣性. (11) [Subtitle]: 平常有志工會幫忙解說導覽. (12) [Subtitle]: 也可以上網預約團體導覽喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 從旁邊往下走. (14) [Logo]: ushi. [Slogan]: food · coffee · shop. [Subtitle]: 居然有一間隱藏的咖啡廳. (15) [Subtitle]: 叫做 嶼食咖啡. (16) [Subtitle]: 據說牛肉麵是必點. (17) [Subtitle]: 不過我們剛好不餓. (18) [Subtitle]: 這裡有一個咖啡廳. (19) [Subtitle]: 我們點了 草莓冰淇淋千層. (20) [Subtitle]: 還有小葉鮮奶茶. (21) [Subtitle]: 都超好吃的. (22) [Subtitle]: 有經過可以來喔.
